title: US adds ‘wrongful detention’ warning for Americans travelling to China
text:
US adds ‘wrongful detention’ warning for Americans travelling to China | South China Morning Post Diplomacy - Diplomacy US adds ‘wrongful detention’ warning for Americans travelling to China 16 Advertisement US-China relations China Diplomacy US adds ‘wrongful detention’ warning for Americans travelling to China 
 US State Department is updating its travel advisory to alert Americans of the risk of being detained arbitrarily under Chinese law
 2 -MIN READ 2 -MIN 16 Listen Han Li in Washington, DC Published: 2:16am, 20 Oct 2026 Updated: 10:16pm, 20 Oct 2026 The US State Department has added a “wrongful detention” warning to its travel advisory for China, alerting Americans to the risk of being detained arbitrarily under Chinese law.
 On Monday, the official China travel advisory added the “D” risk indicator for wrongful detention, while maintaining the country’s overall advisory level at Level 2, or “Exercise Increased Caution”.
 The advisory urges Americans travelling to mainland China to exercise caution due to the “arbitrary enforcement of local laws, the use of exit bans without a fair and transparent process under the law, and the risk of wrongful detention”.
